TASK BRIEF: Fetch bank-transfer payment details (Razorpay)

FIT
Not at all. The supplied request only retrieves details for an existing bank-transfer payment; it does not initiate a bank payment transfer to a vendor. Search for a Razorpay payment, fund-transfer, or payout-creation endpoint instead. The supplied bank-transfer details request is not relevant to the stated task.
